2. Load data - Remove invalid trials - Trials with unaffiliated pedestrians

data_file <- read_csv("master_file.csv") %>% 
  mutate(
    ethnicity = as.factor(ethnicity),
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    location = as.factor(location),
    first_car_yield = as.factor(first_car_yield),
    did_car_proceed_before_across = as.factor(did_car_proceed_before_across),
    ethnicity = fct_relevel(ethnicity, "white")
  )
## Rows: 385 Columns: 15
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (10): ethnicity, gender, location, date, time_of_day, close_side_first_c...
## dbl  (5): order, trial_number, close_side_num_cars_pass_before_yield, num_ca...
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
data <- data_file %>% drop_na(valid_trial)

data_19th_rm <- data %>% filter(location != "19th")

3. General descriptive statistics

data %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_time = mean(time_to_cross_street, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time = sd(time_to_cross_street, na.rm = TRUE), 
    min_time = min(time_to_cross_street, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time = max(time_to_cross_street, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cars = mean(num_cars_pass_before_yield, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_cars = sd(num_cars_pass_before_yield, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

5b. First car yield - Logistic regression

5b1. Gender - Location fixed effects

m1 <- glm(first_car_yield ~ gender + factor(location),
          data = data,
          family = binomial())

tidy(m1)
## # A tibble: 5 × 5
##   term                        estimate std.error statistic      p.value
##   <chr>                          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>        <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)                   -0.738     0.251     -2.94 0.00329     
## 2 genderwoman                    0.644     0.234      2.75 0.00601     
## 3 factor(location)2nd            0.553     0.306      1.81 0.0704      
## 4 factor(location)bessborough    1.28      0.319      4.02 0.0000582   
## 5 factor(location)victoria       2.06      0.360      5.72 0.0000000106
summary(m1)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = first_car_yield ~ gender + factor(location), family = binomial(), 
##     data = data)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                             Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)                  -0.7380     0.2511  -2.939  0.00329 ** 
## genderwoman                   0.6442     0.2345   2.747  0.00601 ** 
## factor(location)2nd           0.5529     0.3056   1.810  0.07036 .  
## factor(location)bessborough   1.2841     0.3194   4.020 5.82e-05 ***
## factor(location)victoria      2.0598     0.3601   5.721 1.06e-08 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 479.28  on 359  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 428.88  on 355  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 438.88
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1)))
## Waiting for profiling to be done...
##                                    OR     2.5 %     97.5 %
## (Intercept)                 0.4780607 0.2890291  0.7759266
## genderwoman                 1.9044585 1.2066155  3.0295057
## factor(location)2nd         1.7383528 0.9580288  3.1810280
## factor(location)bessborough 3.6112638 1.9486782  6.8351217
## factor(location)victoria    7.8446840 3.9574817 16.3270804
ci1 <- exp(confint(m1))
## Waiting for profiling to be done...

5b1b. Gender - Location fixed effects (Bootstrap)

B <- 5000

boot_coefs_m1 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(B),
  function(i) {

    sample_data <- data %>%
      slice_sample(
        n = nrow(data),
        replace = TRUE
      )

    glm(
      first_car_yield ~ gender + factor(location),
      data = sample_data,
      family = binomial()
    ) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      mutate(iteration = i)

  }
)


boot_summary_m1 <- boot_coefs_m1 %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    boot_se = sd(estimate),
    ci_lower = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci_upper = quantile(estimate, 0.975)
  )
## Regular model
summary(m1)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = first_car_yield ~ gender + factor(location), family = binomial(), 
##     data = data)

## factor(location)victoria      2.0598     0.3601   5.721 1.06e-08 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 479.28  on 359  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 428.88  on 355  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 438.88

boot_summary_m1

5b4b. Gender*Ethnicity - Location fixed effects (Bootstrap)

boot_coefs_m4 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(B),
  function(i) {

    sample_data <- data %>%
      slice_sample(
        n = nrow(data),
        replace = TRUE
      )

    glm(
      first_car_yield ~ gender*ethnicity + factor(location),
      data = sample_data,
      family = binomial()
    ) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      mutate(iteration = i)

  }
)


boot_summary_m4 <- boot_coefs_m4 %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    boot_se = sd(estimate),
    ci_lower = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci_upper = quantile(estimate, 0.975)
  )

5c2. Table 1 - First car yield combined models table

table1 <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl1, tbl2, tbl3, tbl4),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "Gender",
    "Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization Interaction"
  )
) %>% 
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>% 
      mutate(
        row_order = case_when(
          variable == "gender" ~ 1,
          variable == "ethnicity" ~ 2,
          variable == "gender:ethnicity" ~ 3,
          variable == "location" ~ 4,
          TRUE ~ 99
        )
      ) %>% 
      arrange(row_order, row_type != "label") %>% 
      select(-row_order)
  )

as_gt(table1) %>% 
  gtsave(
    filename = "table1.docx",
    vwidth = 2200,
    zoom = 2
  )

    ))

6c2. Table 2 - Mean number of cars before yield combined models table

table2 <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl5, tbl6, tbl7, tbl8),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "Gender",
    "Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization Interaction"
  )
) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>% 
      mutate(
        row_order = case_when(
          variable == "(Intercept)" ~ 1,
          variable == "gender" ~ 2,
          variable == "ethnicity" ~ 3,
          variable == "gender:ethnicity" ~ 4,
          variable == "location" ~ 5,
          TRUE ~ 99
        )

      select(-row_order)

7b4b. Gender*Ethnicity - Location fixed effects (Bootstrap)

boot_coefs_m12 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(B),
  function(i) {

    sample_data <- data %>%
      slice_sample(
        n = nrow(data),
        replace = TRUE
      )

    lm(
      time_to_cross_street ~ gender*ethnicity + factor(location),
      data = sample_data
    ) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      mutate(iteration = i)

  }
)


boot_summary_m12 <- boot_coefs_m12 %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    boot_se = sd(estimate),
    ci_lower = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci_upper = quantile(estimate, 0.975)
  )

8b4b. Gender*Ethnicity - Location fixed effects (Bootstrap)

boot_coefs_m16 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(B),
  function(i) {

    sample_data <- data %>%
      slice_sample(
        n = nrow(data),
        replace = TRUE
      )

    glm(
      did_car_proceed_before_across ~ gender*ethnicity + factor(location),
      data = sample_data,
      family = binomial()
    ) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      mutate(iteration = i)

  }
)
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
boot_summary_m16 <- boot_coefs_m16 %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    boot_se = sd(estimate),
    ci_lower = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci_upper = quantile(estimate, 0.975)
  )

8c1. Combined models - Odd Ratio with 95% CI - gtsummary

tbl13 <- tbl_regression(
  m13,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    gender ~ "Gender",
    "factor(location)" ~ "Intersection Location"
  )) %>% 
  modify_column_hide(columns = p.value) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~.x %>% 
      mutate(
        label = case_when(
          label == "man" ~ "Men",
          label == "woman" ~ "Women",
          label == "19th" ~ "19th Street",
          label == "2nd"  ~ "2nd Avenue",
          label == "bessborough" ~ "Bessborough",
          label == "victoria" ~ "Victoria Avenue",
          TRUE ~ label)
    ))

8c2. Table 4 - Car Proceed combined models table

table4 <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl13, tbl14, tbl15, tbl16),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "Gender",
    "Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization Interaction"
  )
) %>% 
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>% 
      mutate(
        row_order = case_when(
          variable == "gender" ~ 1,
          variable == "ethnicity" ~ 2,
          variable == "gender:ethnicity" ~ 3,
          variable == "location" ~ 4,
          TRUE ~ 99
        )
      ) %>% 
      arrange(row_order, row_type != "label") %>% 
      select(-row_order)
  )

as_gt(table4) %>% 
  gtsave(
    filename = "table4.docx",
    vwidth = 2200,
    zoom = 2
  )

9c4b. Gender*Ethnicity - Location fixed effects (Bootstrap)

boot_coefs_m20 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(B),
  function(i) {

    sample_data <- data %>%
      slice_sample(
        n = nrow(data),
        replace = TRUE
      )

    glm(
      car_stop_close_or_far_bin ~ gender*ethnicity + factor(location),
      data = sample_data,
      family = binomial()
    ) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      mutate(iteration = i)

  }
)

tbl17 <- tbl_regression(
  m17,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    gender ~ "Gender",
    "factor(location)" ~ "Intersection Location"

  modify_column_hide(columns = p.value) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~.x %>% 
      mutate(
        label = case_when(
          label == "man" ~ "Men",
          label == "woman" ~ "Women",
          label == "19th" ~ "19th Street",
          label == "2nd"  ~ "2nd Avenue",
          label == "bessborough" ~ "Bessborough",
          label == "victoria" ~ "Victoria Avenue",

9c2. Table 5 - Car yield close//far combined models table

table5 <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl17, tbl18, tbl19, tbl20),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "Gender",
    "Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization",
    "Gender and Racialization Interaction"
  )
) %>% 
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>% 
      mutate(
        row_order = case_when(
          variable == "gender" ~ 1,
          variable == "ethnicity" ~ 2,
          variable == "gender:ethnicity" ~ 3,
          variable == "location" ~ 4,
          TRUE ~ 99
        )
      ) %>% 
      arrange(row_order, row_type != "label") %>% 
      select(-row_order)
  )

as_gt(table5) %>% 
  gtsave(
    filename = "table5.docx",
    vwidth = 2200,
    zoom = 2
  )

10a. Ethnicity

data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = time_to_cross_street,
         fill = ethnicity)) +
  geom_histogram((aes(y = after_stat(density))),binwidth = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = mean(data$time_to_cross_street), sd = sd(data$time_to_cross_street)), colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(
    x = "Time to Cross (s)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
  )
## Warning: Multiple drawing groups in `geom_function()`
## ℹ Did you use the correct group, colour, or fill aesthetics?

params_eth <- data %>%
  group_by(ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(time_to_cross_street),
    sd = sd(time_to_cross_street)
  )

curve_data_eth <- params_eth %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    tibble(
      ethnicity = .$ethnicity,
      x = seq(min(data$time_to_cross_street),
              max(data$time_to_cross_street),
              length.out = 200),
      y = dnorm(x, .$mean, .$sd)
    )
  })

ggplot(data, aes(time_to_cross_street, fill = ethnicity)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = curve_data_eth,
            aes(x = x, y = y),
            colour = "red",
            linewidth = 1,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Time to Cross (s)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ethnicity)

final_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, p4,
          labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D")) +
  theme( 
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
    )

ggsave(
  filename = "figure1.png",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "transparent"
  )
